description: This file manages plugin tools in a system, including importing dependencies, defining types and functions for plugin tool metadata, normalization, resolution, and dynamic loading of plugin tools based on configuration and environment.

classes.name: PluginToolMeta
classes.description: Type representing metadata for plugin tools, including plugin ID and optional flag.

methods.name: getPluginToolMeta
methods.description: Retrieves metadata for a given tool.

methods.name: copyPluginToolMeta
methods.description: Copies plugin metadata from source tool to target tool.

methods.name: resolvePluginTools
methods.description: Resolves and loads plugin tools based on configuration, environment, and existing tools.
